attributes.description: This dashboard provides a comprehensive view of security baseline compliance snapshots from Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

params.markdown:
This dashboard provides a comprehensive view of security baseline compliance snapshots from Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. Each record represents the compliance state for a device, profile, and configuration rule. It highlights baseline passes and baseline failures, trends in events over time by compliance status, and breakdowns by compliance status and OS platform. Top device groups and hosts help identify where baseline gaps are concentrated. Use the controls to filter by group name and compliance status.
 
[Integration Page](/app/integrations/detail/microsoft_defender_endpoint/overview)
